decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the product feed to identify actual backpacks, as many items were miscategorized camping gear like hammocks and tents. For my consideration set, I selected three hydration packs (UDIHEDA, Gelindo, and Lunidry), a specialized baseball backpack (DSLEAF), and a student-focused soccer backpack (Messi). After evaluating reviews, the Gelindo 18L Hiking Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_078) was the clear winner due to its excellent 4.7-star rating across over 1,500 reviews, indicating high reliability and comfort. While some cheaper alternatives were available, the Gelindo provided the best balance of storage capacity and proven durability for the price.
